newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimated Friday 95,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimated Friday 95,000 - USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa/southern Minnesota hog receipts Friday were 95,000 head, compared with 101,000 a week ago and 91,000 a year ago, USDA said. Saturdays estimate was 10,000 head, compared with 11,000 a week ago and 8,000 a year ago.

Estimates include generally about 65 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts $0.50 lower than midsession Thursday. Trade slow for light demand and offerings. Some interests planning reduced kill hours next week.

Compared to last week: Barrows and Gilts 1.50-2.00 higher. Sows 1.00-3.00 higher. Receipts this week 505,000 last week 490,000, last year 496,000. Barrows and Gilts average weight for week ending May 5, 1997 254.4 lbs compared to 254.3 lbs previous week 248.6 lbs last year.
